component.name: drtagger
component.summary: Identify, split and tag audiophile rips

description.p: drtagger takes rips as they circulate — SACD ISOs, CD images with a CUE sheet and folders of lossless tracks — splits images into verified per-track files, identifies the exact release from barcodes, catalog numbers, disc IDs and acoustic fingerprints, and writes MusicBrainz (Picard-style) tags that players read consistently.

ul.li: SACD ISOs extracted to DSF, DST decoded; CD images split to FLAC and checked against CUETools DB
The exact edition found from the rip itself: tags, disc IDs, barcodes and catalog numbers read from the scans, fingerprints, cover comparison
Tags previewed field by field with locks, ReplayGain 2.0, cover art, originals backed up and restorable
The whole queue processed unattended; unsure albums set aside for review, releases already in the library flagged
A rip folder watched in the background: finished rips are tagged and moved into the library with verified copies

description.p: First version: the Mac app's features on GNOME, plus the rip inbox.
